newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to auction bonds worth 3.00 bln rupees.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to auction bonds worth 3.00 bln rupees.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Saturday it had invited tenders by Tuesday for the auction of six-month Short-Term Federal Bonds worth three billion rupees.
It said the tenders would be opened on Tuesday and the results would be announced on Thursday after the new year bank holiday on Wednesday.
Successful bidders will be required to deposit the amount of accepted bids on January 4 through primary dealers, the bank said.
